title: The Play app asks for "display over other apps" though nothing in it uses that
what: The release app lists the permission to draw over other apps. It came from the starter template, which keeps it only for test builds; no screen or native part of MettleUp ever uses it. Google Play and the phone's app info show it to members.
expected: Every permission in the Play app has a reason the member can see; an unused one is left out of the release build.
fix_line: Remove the draw-over-other-apps permission from the release app and from the approved permission list

title: The app ships many open-source parts but never shows their licence notices
what: The Credits page lists only the exercise pictures, the body map and the fonts. The app also ships open-source code (the app framework, Google's Android libraries, Health Connect and Play billing libraries) whose licences ask that their copyright and licence notice go with the app. No screen or file in the app shows them.
expected: An open-source licences page (or file) in the app lists every shipped library with its licence notice.
fix_line: Add an open-source licences list made from the build's library list and open it from Credits

title: Nobody wrote down where the main rest-over chime came from
what: The bell, beep and whistle sounds are made by our own script from plain maths, so they are ours. The default chime they copy their loudness from is not made by that script, and no file says who made it or under what licence. It plays on every rest and is copied into the notification sounds.
expected: Every sound the app ships has a recorded maker and licence, like the pictures and fonts on the Credits page.
fix_line: Record where the chime came from; if unknown, remake it with the same script as the other sounds

items.reason: No USE_EXACT_ALARM or foreground service; billing 8 acknowledges purchases; calories and sleep worded as estimates, not medical. Not visible: the submitted Play data safety and Health apps forms (play-report did not read them; the 3 Nov data safety text is a draft) and the real target API number (set by the framework, printed only in the cloud release check). No WhatsApp, ads or Meta code in this area. Wear: phone side takes watch messages only from its own watch app.
All native parts are Android-only; the missing Apple purchase path for Plus is already tracked in the iPhone parity list and the store shows not available, so no new fault.
Pictures, body map and fonts are credited; widget and shortcut icons are our own vector drawings. Name and logo trademark status is not in this area.
